These barrels can be used to get across holes on the ground. You can also pick up Apples for bonus points, Clocks for extra time, or use Trampolines to jump between portions of each level. If you don't complete a level in time, then a bird will fly by and eat you!

458849.overview:
The Minister approaches the King to tell him that his only daughter, the Princess, wants a new pet. But the King says she already has too many, and she can't take care of so many animals. Thus the Minister purposes a contest of skill and daring to select the Royal Zookeeper. Master Piggy then sends his pupil, Polly, to participate in the contest.

Baku Baku Animal is a variation on the very often copied Tetris type of game. The game has three different play modes: practice, normal and hard. It also can be played by two players against each other (except for the Master System version).

The objective is to pair animal heads with their respective food. If a rabbit head comes falling, you must make it fall on a pile of carrot tiles, dog heads with bones, panda heads with bamboos and monkey heads with bananas. There is a bonus item, the "BB coin", which will appear from times to times, and remove piled tiles from the playfield. Removed tiles will be sent to the opponent's playfield all at once, increasing the difficulty of the task. Polly will face several contestants, and she'll win when her opponents get their playfield piled to the top.

458877.overview:
The universe is made up of human and synthetic lifeforms. Synthetic lifeforms are considered second class citizens by their human counterparts. The story takes place on the prison planet Alpha Prime, a world completely designed for the holding of criminals. You are a synthetic lifeform sentenced for an eternity for a crime you didn't commit and in order to earn your freedom, you must compete against other prisoners in competitions in 10 different incarceration facilities. To compete in these competitions however, you must undergo a procedure that removes your legs and replaces it with a rolling sphere.

There are seven different events to compete in which are Pursuit, Last Man Rolling, Race, King of the Hill, Run the Gauntlet, Tag, and Powerball that pit you not only against your fellow inmates and guards, but against the levels themselves. Run the gauntlet charges you with making it to a goal point within a time limit, all the while avoiding other warriors and obstacles such as flame throwers, spikes, and gun turrets. Pursuit is identical, but it adds the challenge of the arena crumbling away. Powerball has you collecting balls throughout the arena and throwing them at a goalpost before time runs out. Tag has you collecting a set number of tokens that have been scattered throughout the arena within a set time limit.

458909.overview:
Begin Your Story with the Girls of This Epic Anime Fantasy RPG Blue Archive's world immerses you in a detailed fantasy journey, following the stories of the girls in Kivotos. This title blends anime visuals, action, relationships, and RPG strategy. Embark on a journey filled with emotion, adventure, and unforgettable moments.

Step into the role of a teacher in Kivotos, a fantasy city with magical schools and thrilling adventures. Guide students through school experiences and military operations. Each girl's story is part of the Kivotos adventure, creating a vibrant RPG world with heartwarming moments and unforgettable stories.

Form a squad of elite anime girls, each designed for your tactical team. Dive into RPG combat, where every battle is a clash of strategy and skill. Each RPG skirmish is an anime sequence with 3D animations and dramatic flair. Prove your strategic genius across RPG missions in the evolving story.

Every girl in Blue Archive has her own story. These episodes unfold through school events, private chats, and everyday interactions. In MomoTalk, you’ll unlock new sides of each girl, from heartwarming confessions to dramatic events that help shape this fantasy story. It's an RPG of thrilling action and human connection.

Experience a world where anime meets RPG mechanics. Blue Archive’s fantasy environments are home to fascinating school and girls' stories. Whether you're on secret missions, battling through gacha content, or enjoying club antics, every corner invites you into another adventure. Discover more stories in Kivotos with each encounter.

Summon students through the gacha system and build a squad for your playstyle. Each new girl brings strategic possibilities and stories. Your choices affect battle outcomes and story progression, turning each pull into a new RPG experience. Create synergy, develop skills, and lead your team into battle, uncovering secret episodes.

Blue Archive is more than a game—it’s an epic anime RPG with high-stakes fights on a strategic battlefield. Experience the school story brought to life by unforgettable girls in this vast fantasy world. If you crave bonds, adventure, and tactical thrills, start your ultimate anime RPG journey today.

458949.overview:
Baroque Shooting is an arcade vertical-scrolling shooter spin-off from the post-apocalyptic RPG Baroque.

You play as an angel as you fly through the wastes of the Baroque game-world (urban wastes destroyed by an apocalyptic heat wave) in several stages filled with monsters taken from the game gunning for you.

Hitting flying containers releases helpful "parasites" that can be assimilated into your angel and provide weapon power-ups depending on their unique power (fire, thunder or ice). These parasites can be combined in different ways thus giving your angel different weapons and abilities.

458950.overview:
Barbie Beauty Styler is a creative painting / drawing package featuring Barbie and her friends Teresa, Kira and Christie. It is aimed at the younger gamer. There is very little writing, all the icons 'speak' to identify themselves as the mouse passes over them and the game regularly chips in with encouraging comments like 'You're really good at this' and 'Isn't this fun!'.

As the gaming equivalent of dressing up dolls this game's strength lies in its ease of use and the number of possible combinations of model, pose, location, clothes and accessories that can be used to create a picture. Once a picture has been created it can be printed and / or saved in Barbie's Beauty Book.

The game starts by opening Barbie's beauty case, selecting one of the models and whether a full or close-up portrait is going to be used as the starting point. From there the player chooses from one of four locations, Fantasy, Party Fun, Evening Glamour, and Totally Trendy, which will form the background for the picture. Each location has a its own music track and offers five different backgrounds. With these selections made the game displays the model on-screen against the chosen background on the design screen and the real fun begins.

The Design Screen is what this game is all about. Around the screen in two arcs, one on the right the other on the left, are a series of special effects windows. By selecting these the player can use the mouse place sequins on the models dress. This can be done by placing one sequin at a time or my holding down the left mouse button while moving the mouse whole strings of sequins can be used to decorate the dress of any part of the picture.

The arcs that show the available effects can be rotated to bring yet further effects into view. Mistakes can be removed either with the erase icon which restores the picture to its original state, with the undo icon which removes the last placed piece, or any of the three scissors icons which allow parts of a placed adornment to be removed.

Around the edges of the screen are the Styling icons. These change the available effects shown in the design arcs. When the 'Styling Brushes' icon is in use the arcs will show a series of hair effects while the 'Accessories' icon will show sunglasses tiaras etc.

The designer screen also allows player to add animated stamps such as butterflies and raindrops to their picture, change the models outfit and add a friend.

458952.overview:
Check out two of the coolest extreme sports around! With Barbie® Super Sports™ CD-ROM, you can show off your sporting skills as you snowboard through obstacle courses and blade through radical racetracks.

Each sport features five different levels of cool competitions, spectacular stunts, special tricks and even secret areas! Earn points in each level as you meet each new challenge. You're ready, set, go for the most incredible sport thrills and spills ever!

Features:
-Explore 2 cool sporting worlds in one game!
-Enhances hand-eye coordination skills!
-Offers challenges as girls race against the clock!
-Choose your sport! Snowboarding or in-line skating!
-Earn points as you race against the clock, the computer or even your friend!
-Get extreme and outrageous obstacle courses and radical racetracks!
-Cash in points for new equipment to do even cooler tricks and stunts! Or pick up some cool new clothes in the sport shop!

458953.overview:
Barbie as Princess Bride introduces the player to a young Princess Barbie and her childhood friend, Prince Ken. The two grow up close together, fully intending to wed the day they come of age. One day, Prince Ken is called out to sea on a long journey but promises the princess that he will return to marry her one day.

Years pass and Princess Barbie receives word from a Butterfly Fairy that Ken is finally on his way back home. Ecstatic, Princess Barbie hurries to make wedding preparations. The Butterfly Fairy gives Barbie a magic mirror with 12 jewels around it. The 12 jewels correspond to 12 parts of the game. As Barbie completes more of the activities, the image of her Prince in the mirror becomes more clear.

The 12 parts to the game are as follows:
 - A matching game where invitations must be matched to envelopes based on the pictures of the woodland animals to whom the invitations will be delivered.
 - Search for woodland creatures in the forest so that they can be recruited to deliver invitations to their species.
 - Bake a wedding cake by following the recipe and adding the ingredients in the right order, ingredients such as flour, sugar, eggs, butter, harmony, and the gift of giving.
 - Pick decorations for the cake from the Butterfly Fairy's magical garden.
 - Decorate the cake with the chosen decorations.
 - Not really an activity, but a musical interlude where Princess Barbie sings of how excited she is about her upcoming nuptials.
 - Princess Barbie sees that the ring bearer has inadvertently dropped a bunch of important wedding items (like the ring) into the well. Use the bucket to fish out each item.
 - Princess Barbie must meet with the musicians and straighten out their sound by matching sheet music to appropriate instruments and organizing the music pages in the correct order.
 - Ken's ship has met with some rough seas and Princess Barbie must help navigate the ship home safely.
 - Toss coins into various levels of a wishing fountain in order to make Princess Barbie's wish come true.
 - Customize the wedding dress and bouquet for both Barbie and her flower girl.
 - The wedding has transpired; the only thing left to do is customize the wedding photo.

458954.overview:
Barbie Beach Vacation takes her and her friends to the the sands and the waves of a remote island. Like most Barbie titles, it's geared towards 5-9 year olds.

There are plenty of activities to occupy Barbie when she gets tired of soaking up rays. Since this is a Barbie game, of course Barbie can choose her attire from dozens of bathing suits and beach outfits. She can surf or water ski, build a sandcastle, snorkel, photograph marine life and hula dance. You can win prizes for doing well in each activity. Prizes are items like beach umbrellas and tiki torches that can be used to decorate the beach for the final stage of the game - the big beach party.

458955.overview:
You find yourself in possession of an ornate bottle and take it to an antique shop to have the bottle evaluated and appraised. The storekeeper informs you that the bottle is magic and that all you need to do is rub it. Suddenly, Barbie emerges from the bottle in genie form and explains her plight -- an evil genie in the employ of a sinister sultan stole her powers. She requests your help to retrieve her powers and defeat the bad sultan and genie.

Barbie Magic Genie Bottle is a computer game that is packaged with a custom-purpose input peripheral -- an actual genie bottle that attaches to a Windows PC via a standard PC 15-pin joystick port. The bottle is used to invoke special actions during the game and is thus a required component of the gameplay.

Barbie transports the player to the distant land where you will be assisting her. Barbie needs the player to visit 5 different lands and collect 5 different gems. In order to collect the gem in each land, the player must solve a puzzle. Solving the puzzle requires collecting 5 puzzle pieces scattered about the land.

Gameplay involves navigating through a first-person 3D city on foot and via flying carpet, which raises the player up to a higher plane. All the while, Barbie is in tow lending advice. Throughout different cities, the player also has to interact with other people and complete sub-quests that they assign in order to advance the game.

458957.overview:
In Banzai Bug you play a fly who has been trapped in the house of an exterminator, now with the help of a couple of other insects you have to escape.

You control your bug in a 3rd-person view as you fly around and complete different missions like stealing matches, collecting earwax or navigate the vents.

458959.overview:
In Barbie Cool Looks Fashion Designer the player can select clothes for Barbie Christie, Kira or Teresa. The player selects the clothes from those on display in the girl's room which they can then customise by choosing from eighty-four fabric designs, colouring them from a thirty-five colour palette (though only four colours per design are allowed), and have the girls model the clothes at the mall, office, park, beach or in their bedroom. The player's creations are saved in a wardrobe and can be revisited at any time to be worn by any of the games characters.

Clothes consist of a range of hats, dresses, shirts, skirts, pants, accessories and jackets etc. The player clicks on an item in a girl's room and then scrolls through the available options, at this stage all the clothes are white. Once something pleasing has been found the player then proceeds to the design part of the game where the clothes can be coloured in giving, for example, an all black jacket or a pattern can be selected in which case individual parts of the pattern can be coloured in. Once designed these can be exported and shared with other players who have the same game or they can be printed.
The clothing options available vary depending on the location they are going to so, for example, if we're taking Christie to the beach the dress would be replaced with a swimsuit, handbags would be replaced by beach bags, shoes would be replaced by sandals etc.

The print function is an important feature of this game as in-game photos of the girls modelling the new clothes can be printed in colour as gifts, in black and white to be coloured in off live. Patterns for Barbie fashion accessories, both for the player and the doll, can also be printed along with assembly instructions. The tutorial also refers to printing dress patterns on Barbie Fashion Fabric but it is not clear whether this is a print of a plain pattern or the players entire design colours and all.

Within the game all instructions are spoken - there is nothing to read on screen.

458960.overview:
Baltic Mission is a game in the style of Globetrotter, made by the same developer, but focused on the Baltic area.

The game was produced with the intent of spreading more tourist & business information about the eastern Baltic states; Latvia, Lithuania, Estonia, Poland and the North-Western region of Russia, when these countries were adopting to market economies - the target audience is Swedish-speaking only, with possible future translations not happening due to lack of funding.

The game has 22 locations to visit in the included regions, and additional cities with descriptions could be added by the players themselves, and up/downloaded on the games homepage - (this is unfortunately now defunct).

At the game start a player is asked whether to start a new game with the 22 built-in cities, or to create their own city, adding to it new descriptions and questions of the players own choice.

The default game has the player starting out in Stockholm, Sweden, in one of four roles: student, journalist, businessman or travel agent. In either role, you get a mission to accomplish by travelling to a number of cities and talking to people to gain specific information for the mission.

The player starts out with a small amount of money, and both hotels and travelling costs a varied sum of money.

Start with examining a map to find the locations of the train station, harbour or airport from which you can travel to your intended area. The map has a number of locations marked, some of which hold information, some questions, and other has physical locations. Sometimes a minigame can be played when a location is selected; picking out item or location names from images, a customs baggage check, a street hustlers gambling event: guess which cup a coin is hidden under.

After checking in to a hotel, it is possible to meet people in the city and have conversations - which mostly consist of questions about the country you are in, and you gain money for giving correct answers. If the person you talk to thinks you have answered enough questions correctly, you are considered a friend with common interests.

Once a mission is completed, it ends up in the local high score list - which originally also could be compared online.

As opposed to the original Backpacker series, you can not take any local jobs to earn more money, instead if the money runs out you can call home for more, a limited number of times.

458961.overview:
Barbie Pet Rescue lets kids play with and care for a variety of domesticated animals. Visit Barbie and her kid sister Stacey at the Pet Rescue Center, where you'll wait for rescue missions, explore in the playrooms, or tend to pets in the Care Center.

Rescue missions come in over the phone or via e-mail; after learning which pet is missing where, travel with Barbie on her scooter to one of three different environments in which to search for one of eight lost pets. In many missions, you'll have to figure out how to entice scared animals to come to you, or how to retrieve pets trapped in trees or other sticky situations. If you get stuck yourself, Barbie will give you hints. With each successful mission, you'll receive a printable Paw & Purr Award that hangs on the Pet Rescue Center wall.

Rescued pets come back to the Pet Rescue Center with you and Barbie to wait for their owners and receive a little TLC. Nurse them back to health in the Care Center, where you'll give recovered pets water, treats, vitamins and grooming. You may also need to bandage a hurt leg or pick burrs from ruffled fur. After creating a file for them in the computer and giving them a name you select from a list of suggestions, the animals go to one of two playrooms to wait for their owners.

In the meantime, you can play with them, plus all the other pets already in the playroom--a kitten, bunny, hamster, puppy, and a turtle. Select which animal you'd like to pet, then use the cursor to stroke an animal's head or back or scratch it under the chin. The animals respond to your attention by licking, rolling over, purring, or barking.

There is a related mini-game for each kind of animal--Kitten Keepaway, Puppy Treat Toss, Hamster Trail, etc.--and if you do well enough, you'll see the animal perform a special trick. A few of the games require the use of logic and spatial aptitude, but for the most part they challenge the players' mouse mastery and hand-eye coordination.

458962.overview: Imagine a square checkered board. Put on it balls on starting places that show a starting direction thanks to arrows on them. The goal of the game is easy: guide the balls to the exit. Simple, yes, but you will have to avoid spikes, you will encounter corners that change the direction and depending on the ball (i.e. plastic, metal), its behaviour won't be the same: for example, beware of magnets using a metal ball.

458967.overview:
Barkanoid is a clone of the game Arkanoid. Although basic gameplay is the same, Barkanoid has 100 levels, 35 collectibles and more monsters.

The Windows 3.x version is played in a window without a DirectX full-screen mode.

458980.overview: Barbie Generation Girl Gotta Groove CD-ROM is a creativity game that offers Barbie fans the opportunity to choose a character (Barbie, Marissa, Nichelle, Susie, Chelsie or Marie), dress her up, choose music and perform her own dances. Girls can train, print cards, and record up to 9 dance sessions. The program can also import pictures from the Barbie Photo Designer digital camera. Barbie Generation Girl Gotta Groove CD-ROM is aimed at ages 5 and up.

459011.overview:
You own a major league baseball team, and it is your job to build the team up into a champion team. This not only includes buying players, coaching staff and other staff members, but the stadium, behind the scenes money matters and a whole lot more. In truth you aren't controlling a baseball team, you controlling a company that owns a baseball team, and that company needs leadership.

The latest MLB stats are available in all categories, from player ability to their current salary terms. Every single stat becomes important to the success of your team, like the crowds support and memberships or locker room conditions.

And if you want even more control, you can modify areas of the MLB itself. Move a club from one place to another, re-name them, change their colors, etc, etc.

459013.overview: Battlefleet Commander II is a BattleShip variant. Two players place their fleet on the playing field. Available are the German and Japanese fleet and the Royal and US Navy. The player has to try and hit a ship by shooting at certain coordinates. If he does not hit, the next player starts his turn. If he hits, he can shoot again. If a player sinks the entire fleet, he wins. Three single player campaigns are included as well as an option to play versus another human opponent via LAN or internet.

459018.overview:
Bas de Beer naar Pirateneiland is the first of the Dutch Bas de Beer games. It is meant for players between the ages of four and ten. The players follow the story of Bas de Beer (Bas the Bear) who finds an old chest called Kraak in an attic. Kraak starts telling the story of a pirate treasure buried on Pirateneiland (Pirate Island) put there by Éénoog (One Eye). Together with his uncle Bob, Bas decides to find the treasure Kraak has told about.

While on the adventure, Bas is unwillingly accompanied by the evil Professor Punthoofd (Pointy Head), who hid inside the ship when it left. When they arrive on the island, they are greeted by the natives, and with their help they start their journey to find the treasure.

459032.overview: Battle Isle 2220: Shadow of the Emperor is a hex-based strategy game featuring live-action video sequences and real-time 3D fight animations.

459033.overview: The Battle of Britain is a strategic simulation about the Battle of Britain in 1940. You are a the commander of the Royal Air Force and plan the defense against the German attacks. You will do this with the help of the identical tote-board system. Radar tracking, reports on enemy troop movements and analysis of unidentified planes need fast decision making that will decide whether you succeed or not. The player needs to keep an eye on plane and pilot losses and shrinking resources.

459034.overview:
Battle of Britain is a turn-based simulation of aerial fights between Germany and Britain in 1940. There are two campaigns with two different goals: The Britons need to defend their country and Germany wants to conquer it.

As expected of such a game the most time is spent on a overhead map of Britain and northern Europe and several statistics screens. The rounds are divided into two parts: In the first both Britain and Germany give orders to their forces, in the second these orders are carried out in real time. During this the game can be paused at any time to give further orders. The success is measured by points which the player receives for certain actions, e.g. destroying an enemy aircraft.

459035.overview:
First in the long-running Battleground wargame series. The game offers turn-based wargaming using the first incarnation of the Battleview engine and featuring 23 battles between Dec. 1944 and Jan. 1945 on the Ardennes Forest and its surroundings. Plus you get 3 hypothetical scenarios, 1 tutorial scenario and a scenario editor to fiddle with the premade missions.

Uses svga graphics in an isometric or top-down tactical map. Plus the game also includes small fmv sequences that play whenever a certain action is carried out and offers modem support for two-player gameplay.

459036.overview:
223 BC, the battle between Chu kingdom and the country of Qin began. From sunrise to sunset, the battle continued for five days and five nights. Finally, the forces of Chu were defeated. Qin became an empire, ruled by the ruthless First Emperor, Qin Shihuang. That time, Xiang Yu was just a little boy. But as he grew up, he realized he must do something to bring freedom back to his country Chu, and to stop the terrible regime of Qin Dynasty. But he does not know that his duties as a patriot and his feelings for a woman may lead to a tragic conflict...

Based on a popular classic Chinese story, "Bawang Bie Ji" is a Chinese RPG in spirit of Xuanyuan Jian and Xianjian Qixia Zhuan. You navigate Xiang Yu and his party over the world map, entering towns and hostile areas. Enemy encounters are random. The battles are turn-based and are viewed from an isometric perspective.

459037.overview:
This turret gun shooter is a remake of Beach Head 2002 but it changes the location to the Iraqi desert. It's only available as a downloadable purchase.

From a stationary position, you can rotate 360 degrees to shoot at any approaching enemies. The main military force has met little resistance in the desert, so it has moved onward towards the capital. You have been left to guard a rear position when the enemy's elite forces regroup and unleash a last desperate surprise attack.

You must keep them at bay in both day and night attacks. At night, you have night vision and the use of flares and searchlights. There's new APC's (Armored Personnel Carriers) armed with gun turrets and missile launchers, and you also have a new heat seeking missile launcher. You must repel both land and air attacks and gather diverse ammo drops including bullets, missiles and shells.

459039.overview:
Beach Head 2002 is a 360 degree shooter in a photorealistic 3D environment. You are a lone gunner in a machine gun nest somewhere in the middle of a war. Your task is to keep your area clean - which means, that you need to shoot down everything that moves. And there is much movement - Marine Infantry transporters will drive up and unload a fresh batch of cannonfodder, helicopters will circle above and shoot you with their guns, tanks creep up bombarding you with shells...

To kill them all, you have quite an arsenal of deadly weapons: first of all, your trusty machine gun. You can rotate 360 degrees and crush your opponents into pieces with this huge weapon. You don't have unlimited ammo but usually it should be enough for killing all human life on the area. If this fails (when dealing with helicopters or tanks, for example), you can unleash some more power with your - limited amount - of rockets. They explode a tank or helicopter in one shot but you need to target really well - most of the usual rocket targets are moving. And if you are out of ammo for the machine gun and there is some marine soldier annoying you, pull out your pistol and finish him off!

The game has unlimited levels with increasing difficulty. A multiplayer mode is not included.

459150.overview:
MahJongg: Game of Four Winds is a single player implementation of the traditional game for four players in which the player takes on three AI opponents. It was created by Berrie Bloem in the early 1990's and was nominated for the "Shareware Industry Awards 1996".

MahJongg: Game of Four Winds comes with many game configuration options, players can* customise the rules, the scoring and the discards
 - They can choose to see all hands or just their own
 - Change the background, tile set, and animation

The game includes a comprehensive help file and a tutorial explaining in detail all the rules and options.
Additional backgrounds could be downloaded for free from eGames 'Mahjongg Parlor' website

459151.overview:
Beyond Time is an inventory-based, mouse-driven adventure game based on the novel Obelisk by Dr. Judith Kaye Jones. "Obelisk" was the name given to it by the original designers when it was completed in 1995, but it was never published under that name. DreamCatcher picked it up for publishing 2 years later under the name Beyond Time, appropriate because the story does involve time travelling.

Rifts in time have occurred causing people and precious artifacts and treasures to disappear mysteriously all over the world. Travel to ancient Egypt, Tibet, the Yucatan peninsula and Atlantis to find the missing masterpieces of the world and repair time itself. Only your puzzle-solving skills can save humanity from impending doom.

459157.overview: A fast paced action game where you run around a machine-gun wielding robot destroying everything in your path. There is a multitude of enemies and you

459158.overview: In Beetle Ju you control a little bug who has to overcome a variety of dangers. Help Beetle Ju through a labyrinth by digging up the path and moving or blowing up boulders. Different Weapons like grenades, rockets and bombs are available. Use these weapons against monsters and defeat a set number of them in every of the 100 levels.

459159.overview:
Benjamin Blümchen: Das Gespensterspiel is based on the long-running German children's audio play series starring talking elephant Benjamin Blümchen and his friends. In the game, Benjamin and his friend Otto are visiting their friend Kasimir. Kasimir is a ghost on castle Eintracht and is hunted by an other ghost. He asks them to help him to deal with the ghost.

This title is a simple adventure game. The puzzles are specially designed for children about the age of seven and include puzzles like spotting mistakes on images.
459159.developer: bvm Gesellschaft fur Konzeption und Gestaltung digitaler Medien

459161.overview: Benjamin Blümchen: Das Reporterspiel is an adventure game for children. Benjamin Blümchen and Otto want to help Karla Kolumna with her newspaper work and have to take photos for that. To find the right motives, different tasks at different locations have to be solved.
459161.developer: bvm Gesellschaft fur Konzeption und Gestaltung digitaler Medien

459162.overview:
In Berlin Connection the player is journalist Roger Penrose who researches the fall of the Berlin Wall. In November 1989 he visits Berlin but he and his contact get into the visor of the Stasi … During his research he has to undertake three time travels, e.g. to the Building of the Berlin Wall.

The game is played using the first-person perspective in a 360° view. The player moves through photographs and clicks on items of interest. The camera is an important item because some puzzles are based on photographing the right things or locations. The game design consists of different types of challenges: there are logic puzzles, labyrinths, timed puzzles and inventory puzzles, but the main focus lies in the gathering of information and knowledge about the historic backgrounds – if no attention is paid to them, it becomes difficult to find the hotspots.

459164.overview:
The Best Pop Pub Quiz Ever! is a game for one to four players based on pop music up to the late 1990's. It is based on Carlton Books of the same name and boasts six thousand questions in fifty categories, three difficulty levels and options to print quizzes and answer sheets for pub quiz organisers.
All quizzes are twenty questions long. The questions are text based, there are no sound clips, and all answers must be correctly spelled when they are typed in. Questions are asked of the participating players in turn as their avatars sit at a bar drinking and performing various antics. As the quiz progresses a status bar shows how many questions each has got right. The game does not show the correct answers by default, if the players opt to see the correct answer it pops up, very briefly, in it's own window .

459166.overview:
Imagine the classic Arcade game 1942 in 3D. You have a choice of flying 3 different WW2 planes in 25 Single Player Missions and 5 scenarios. While the game starts with classic weapon systems such as machine guns, you can power up to rockets and strange rayguns later on.

Enemies consist of Bombers, Cruisers, Battleships, Tanks, Pursuit Planes etc. The game has 3D positional audio and allows for 8 player dogfights.

459168.overview:
Join Bek on his journey to save the entire canine species from an extinction caused by the sinister Dooper Virus. Inject yourself into a zany hand-drawn world of germs, cells, and winding passages full of vibrant characters and ferocious bosses with a story that takes place inside our beloved pets.

Give your dog a fighting chance by aiding its immune system to fight off the Dooper Virus. Befriend cells on your journey, absorb new powers from vanquished foes and explore vital organs to prevent them from failing! Will you be the vaccine to save dog-kind from extinction?

459352.overview:
Winner of the Reboot Develop "Visual Excellence" award.
Winner at the 2021 WN Dev Contest as chosen by Epic Games.

Bygone Dreams is a high fantasy action adventure with RPG elements set in a surreal dream world.

The dream land of Lume, under the protection of its matron deity, is being threatened by a terrible Nightmare. Embodying the spirit known as Wa, you are the world's last hope for survival.

To aid you in your quest, you must seek out the world's Guardians - powerful creatures worshiped and revered in times long before the corruption seeped in. However, the task ahead is anything but easy, as the Guardians themselves succumbed to the Nightmare.

459357.overview: "Blade Abyss: Death Raid" is a skill-driven hardcore action game, blending precise parry, dynamic movement, and tactical axe throws. Face demonic bosses and zombie hordes in fast-paced combat—no gear, no grind, only pure mastery of mechanics. Your reflexes are the ultimate weapon.

459378.overview: Germany in 1945. Behind enemy lines, an Allied parachute fighter with a delicate mission jumps out of a burning American plane at the last moment. His task: to make his way to Berlin and liquidate a high-ranking Nazi officer there. But this job is anything but easy, because the road to Berlin is long and countless opponents are just waiting to NOT take any prisoners

459395.overview: Bibi Blocksberg: Chaos in der Hexenschule is an adventure game for children. New spells have been learned at witch school, and Bibi and her friends want to try them out at the funfair. But everything goes wrong and chaos ensues. Can the three witches put everything back in order?

459397.overview: Bibi Blocksberg: Meine große Hexprüfung is a licensed Bibi Blocksberg game released in German speaking countries. During 9 different mini games the protagonist Bibi has to pass various challenges to be a real witch. These challenges are e.g. about mixing several witch potions or citing certains witch spells correctly.
459397.developer: bvm Gesellschaft fur Konzeption und Gestaltung digitaler Medien

459398.overview: Bibi Blocksberg: Verhexte Ferien is an adventure game for children. Bibi goes into summer camp, and strange things start happening. Another witch must be responsible! Help Bibi and her friends to figure out the causes for the strange witchcraft and find a treasure. Investigate different locations, find useful items and use them to get more hints.

459399.overview: Bibi und Tina: Spuk im Zeltlager is a detective game for children. Camp leader Paul Pingel's clothes disappear at the camp. The ponies are also dusted with flour and nettles are hidden in the sleeping bags. Solve the puzzle and find the culprit.
459399.developer: bvm Gesellschaft fur Konzeption und Gestaltung digitaler Medien

459400.overview: A diverse arcade racing game with 16 different vehicles (not just cars, but also boats, trucks, spacecraft, and helicopters) to race. There are 24 circuits across 7 distinct terrains such as dirt, inner city and a futuristic sci-fi setting. Multiplayer games can be split-screen, modem or network based. In addition to a yoof-style soundtrack, audio commentary is on offer. The appearance of your vehicle can be customised, and the action viewed from multiple camera angles.

459402.overview:
Bicycle Solitaire, the classic American card game, has over 50 different versions of Solitaire, including favorites like Klondike, with varying skill levels: Hard, Medium, Easy, Favorites and Kids.

No need for a scratch pad to keep your score, Bicycle Solitaire tracks all scores with a click of a mouse.

Bicycle Solitaire allows you to Undo a mistake. It also includes an Hint option to coach you on the best move to make. Different patterned table tops and card backs are available to keep you interested.

459403.overview:
Bicycle Pinochle includes over 6 different variations and multiple playing options for this classic American card game. Bicycle Pinochle keeps track of bidding and scoring, all available at a mouse click. It supports modem or network play along with 9 computer characters of varying skill levels.

If you don't know how to play, Bicycle Pinochle provides a Tutorial mode and Practice mode to hone your skills. Making a mistake is never a problem. The undo button allows you to fix errors or to try other cards in situations.

459404.overview:
Bingo Master is a customised version of Soleau Software's Bingo Buddies.

This game is played using the US version of bingo cards, i.e the cards are a 5x5 square with just the central square being 'free'. Games are played won by completing a variety of patterns, whereas in the UK games are generally won by just lines, corners or a full house.

The player starts by competing with some AI friends in small time bingo games to win a bankroll, they then compete against up to forty unseen AI players in one of the themed games, all games are identical but the backgrounds are different. As with real bingo there are bonuses awarded for winning a round in a specified number of calls.
Players can play up to three cards in a game and can choose between marking their cards manually or having the game do it for them, when played manually the CTRL and ALT keys are used to 'shout BINGO!'

Also available here are in-game rules, a history of the game, and the option to have the game call out numbers so the player can play at home with friends using pen & paper.

A 'Special Edition' of this game with a reduced number of locations was included in a number of eGames' compilation CDs.

459405.overview:
Bicycle Solitaire simulates various kinds of card game 'Solitaire' with several official Bicycle card backs to the company's 125th Anniversary.

It is possible to play 52 variations as follows:
 - Klondike (Pas Seul, Klondike, Double Klondike, Double Klondike 2, Gargantua, East Haven, Blind Alleys, Batsford, Big Harp, Achtmal Acht)
 - Golf (Relaxed Golf, Golf, Dead King Golf, Elevator)
 - Pick 2 (Advanced Clamp, Avalanche, Battle Lines, Breech, Car Wash, Circus Tent, DragonFly, School of Turtles, Umbrella, Wrestler)
 - 3 Towers (3 Towers, Battery, Clamp, Crossbow, Divide and Conquer, Falcon, Grip Tower, Lobster, Super 3 Towers, The Mirror)
 - Best 21 (Rabbit in the Hole, Black Mamba, Hula Hooper, Best 21, Scooter's Game, Truffle, Lady Luck)
 - Pyramid (Double Deal Pyramid, Single Deal Pyramid, Single Deal Pyramid 2, No Deal Pyramid)
 - Forty Thieves (Forty Thieves, Diplomat, Deuces, Number Ten)
 - Spiderette (Spiderette, Super Spiderette)
 - Spider
 - Bonus (Red and Black, The Mill, The Square, Two Rings)

The main goal is to move all the cards to the foundations. The trick of this computer variation is introduction of time-oriented bonus. In case if moves to foundations are performed quickly one-by-one, the game proposes a possibility to either substitute some card with a Joker or remove a blocking card, etc. Points are gained by the player for each victory in the solitaire game. These points allow to unlock more card backs and table environments. The gameplay is accompanied with music. The game may be saved in progress to restore it later.

459406.overview:
Big Brother: The Game 2 is the official game about the second season of the German version of the TV show.

Instead of one playing mode like the first game this features four:
 - Budget Breaking: The player has to catch food which comes flying from the top of the screen. He has to match their prices to the budget.
 - Do the Dishes: The same as above just with dishes and without the budget.
 - Take 12: A sliding puzzle where the player has to assemble photos from the show.
 - Photo Fun: This game gets unlocked when the player beats the other three games. This is a Moorhuhn variant where he has to photograph things that fly through the screen. When a photographed motive is far away more points are granted.

Just like the first game the player can pick any candidate he wishes. The game also features several bonus videos from the show, an internet high-score list and spoken commentary by the presenters Oliver Geissen and Aleksandra Bechtel.

459407.overview:
In a secret laboratory in a hidden research facility, artificial intelligence waits to be awakened. Artificially intelligent robots with human characteristics were created and originally intended to assist the human race. But, before the project could be completed, something went awry. Why was the Bioscopia research station abandoned? What happened to the scientists?

Another research scientist was determined to find the answers to those questions and she, herself, becomes trapped within the complex. You are sent to find her and are plunged into a graphically intense world where science rules. Zoology, biology, botany and genetics are the keys to finding the scientist and unlocking Bioscopia's secrets.

In first person perspective, explore the detailed rooms and grounds of Bioscopia. Find information in the computers and written documents. Discover items to use in a multitude of puzzles. Rely on your common sense and deductive abilities as well as what you have learned within the game itself to rescue the lost researcher.

459409.overview: Birthright: The Gorgon's Alliance is a strategy role-playing game based on TSR's Birthright world of Anuire. It combines first person dungeon and castle quests, tactical real-time graphical battles, and complex economic and diplomatic strategy. Play against challenging computer opponents or other cunning human players.

459411.overview: Hunting deer not enough for you? Get ready with your bird guns as you get your chances to shoot at 15 different species of birds... Virtually. Different birds require different strategies, and you can even get a few AI dogs to help you flush out the prey for you to shoot. And the dogs will even retrieve the prey... If you hit it, that is. You even get to pick the different species of dogs, different weapons, different locations, and equipment such as calls, decoys, and blinds.

459413.overview:
Bicycle Casino Games is a licensed game that simulates casino life. Choose a character and try your luck at one of the three casinos, based on real-life locations: The Mirage, Bellagio and Treasure Island. There is a help function to learn the different games, and each casino has rooms where the different games are selected. Some games are played alone, while in others you will be joined by animated computer-controlled players.

The available games are:
 - Baccarat
 - Big 6 Wheel
 - Carribean Stud Poker
 - Craps
 - European Roulette
 - Five-Card Draw (Poker)
 - Mini Baccarat
 - Omaha Hold'Em (Poker)
 - Pai Gow Poker
 - Roulette
 - Seved-Card Stud (Poker)
 - Slots
 - Three-Reel Slot Machines
 - Texas Hold'Em (Poker)
 - Video Keno
 - Video Poker
 - Video Slots

The player can also play the Casino Challenge Tournament, where they compete against a variety of computer opponents in all games at the different casinos. A ranking shows their progess. If the challenge is won or the comp card is completely filled, the High Roller room in the Bellagio is opened up.

459414.overview:
Big Brother: The Game is based on the German version of the TV show where multiple people live in one house and get filmed all day. The gameplay? Well, it is Pac-Man. The player controls one candidate through a labyrinth and collects different things which are lying on the ground. What exactly depends on the stage, examples are grass or dog turds. While doing this he gets pursued by the other candidates; when touching them he loses one of his three lives.

When completing stages the player unlocks twenty videos from the show. The game also features bios and pictures of the candidates and an internet high-score list.

459415.overview:
Big Oil is a simulation where the player manages a company in the oil business. The first part is played like most tycoon games: the player finds himself on a undeveloped piece of land and constructs all the buildings and infrastructure necessary for a functional oil production. This includes a city for the workers. Then, in theory, the player can lean himself back and watch how the business is developing.

But because the player manages a big company there are many such production sites to care for. And because the whole game is played in real-time - the slowest setting is one day per second - this results in a hectic gameplay where fast decisions have to be made. Especially when a few events happen at the first time, e.g. a new research result or a country sells a new drilling permit.

The game features a free playing mode from 1900 to 2000 (without AI opponents) and 17 historical scenarios, e.g. directly after Pearl Harbor. Additionally the player can choose between two playing modes. In the extended mode the player has to care about everything on every branch, the easy mode focuses more about the overall economic management.

459416.overview: A variation of Monopoly, Billionaire has more money and more expensive property. Players can build houses, buildings, skyscrapers, offices, and more, and charge any amount of rent for their property. Players also have the ability to buy businesses, build their own companies, invest in stocks, and even win the lottery. It is possible to play against the computer or one human opponent.

459423.overview:
Based on the 1995 movie Cover Me, Blue Heat is a mature-themed, photo-realistic adventure game. The player assumes the role of Holly Jacobson, a detective with the Los Angeles Police Department who goes under cover to catch a serial killer preying on the sexy cover girls of LA Erotica Magazine. Several have already been murdered and many others are in danger.

The game takes players in the steamy world of erotic dancers, Mafia thugs, fashion photographers, drug dealers, religious zealots and seductive models. As Holly, players will talk with other characters, determine who has an alibi for the previous murders, gather evidence to send to the lab and read information inside her PDA. Eventually enough information will be discovered to pin-point the identity of the killer. Ultimately the player will participate in a "sting" to expose and catch the murderer.

Gameplay is point-and-click in first person, with movie-like quality video cutscenes and orchestrated music. Navigation to different locations is handled with an area map. Within the gameplay screen, move around using an arrow cursor which changes shape on interactive spots.

Blue Heat has several different endings depending upon which conversation paths have been chosen as well as the evidence submitted for lab analysis.

459425.overview:
Simon (your alter ego) is a blind man who takes a journey through memories and emotions in search of truth: someone is killing your best friends, and you are one of the suspects.

Blindness is an adventure game which can, thanks to its "interactive 3D audio system", be played also by blind people. Scenes were filmed with professional actors in Rome and in Cinecittà studios. The game has multiple endings, which vary depending on the items found during the adventure.

459426.overview:
Help Bob and his team to build a park! Enjoy 10 different activities including:

Build a Park with Bob - Create endless exciting park designs adding ponds, band stands and flowers. And then view the park in all the different seasons and print out your design!

Skateboard Spud - Fix the broken skateboard with Bob and then help Spud perform amazing tricks and stunts!

Bob's Crazy Golf- Help Muck around a maze to collect the pieces he needs to create his golf course.

Farmer Pickles' Pets' Corner - Help collect food to lure the various animals into their correct homes!

Lofty's Squirrel Run- Help Lofty to build a run, so the hungry squirrels can reach their nuts.

Mr Ellis' Dinosaur Discovery - Choose to build up to 3 dinosaur skeletons with Bob and Mr Ellis.

459435.overview: Boat Fury is a 17th century sailing ship simulator that lets you play single missions or embark on a full-fledged campaign. Choose a faction from Pirate, Republic of Venice, Kingdom of Spain or Kingdom of England. Buy low, sell high at sea ports and sail using the map and compass. Fight against enemy vessels on the open sea to protect your shipment.

459444.overview:
A computer version of the classic word finding game. 16 lettered dice are rolled and arranged in a square. The player then has a limited amount of time to find as many words as possible in the grid.

New game variations for the computer include a 4X4X4 cube of dice for finding words, a head-to-head game where players place the dice themselves before looking for words, and two tetris-like games where players must find words among onrushing Boggle dice.

459445.overview:
Bomb Wuzel 2 is the continuation of Bomb Wuzel 3D and instructions to the game are also the same. In this title puzzle skills are even more required.

In this second part Wuzel must eliminate explosive figure without destroying himself on boards with different tile layouts. There are larger levels, more enemies and many extras that make things more difficult. There are new floor tiles characteristics such as infested ones along with extended abilities for more complex strategies.

A further innovation is Wuzeline, which is an alternative character that can be selected for playing. Wuzeline does not have other characteristics than Wuzel, it only looks different.

459447.overview:
Bonn Ouvert is a humorous simulation of the card game skat. There are many variants, but here is the principle: the game is usually played with three persons. Two of the players are playing against a single one, but are not allowed to communicate. Each card has a value and one suit is called "Trumpf". In every round each player loses one of his cards and the one who played the "Trumpf" card with the highest value gets all the played cards. If no "Trumpf" is played, the highest value wins. At the end each player counts the value of his cards. The goal for the single player is to get more points than the other two combined.

The main catch of the game is that all seven computer opponents are parodies of German politicians, including Helmut Kohl and Gerhard Schröder. During the game they talk in politician's platitudes. The game offers several skat variants and five card sets. With the editor the player can create his own sets.

459449.overview:
Boule & Bill: Boule a rétréci ! is a game inspired by the Boule & Billcomics series, created by Jean Roba. To make things clear, Boule is the dog (a Cocker Spaniel) and Bill is the young boy.

Bill's father has accidentally shrunk Boule with a strange machine (ring bells ? answer is the comic film: Honey, I Shrunk the Kids). So Bill will have to bring back Boule to its normal size after 7 mini-games of action (in the garden, beware of giant insects) and logic (such as a maze).

The game features two levels of difficulty and in the end, the opportunity to print drawings.

459450.overview:
This clone of Boulder Dash introduces Lou Verne, an adventurer descended into the Earth's interior. The 50 levels of the game is a story he tells about horrors, treasures and mysteries of all kinds he experienced below.

In each cave Lou Verne must collect a certain number of diamonds to progress to the next cave. But the job is complicated with many obstacles on his way. Time limit, monsters, complex boulder formations, blocked caves and disgusting mucus require all his skills.

The ability to get the nearest diamond holding the "Ctrl" key is present. Each level may be accessed with a password. The game is available for 1 or 2 players, playing consequently. Best scores are stored in Hi-Score table. The game includes Audio CD tracks, which player may switch during gameplay.

459451.overview:
Bowling Mania is a one or two player game with four modes of play, open play which is a single player mode, player vs player, player vs computer, and tournament mode.

The game has three difficulty levels, a choice of eight player characters, and eight themed alleys; Jungle, Castle, the 1950's, Haunted, Junkyard, Saloon, Traditional, and Sci-Fi. The player's character is moved into position by dragging it right/left at the end of the lane. The bowling action is controlled by a double power meter affair in the lower right of the screen. The first click starts the power meter increasing, the second click stops the power meter an starts a direction meter, the third click starts the ball rolling.

The game has optional sound effects and music.

459503.overview:
Brain Games 2 is a compilation of four casual games previously sold by Webfoot Technologies, Inc.. The games are:
 - 3D Marble Flip (here just called Marble Flip*)
 - 3D Super Row Mania (here called Super Rows)
 - Nomi
 - Zan

Also included is a demo version of the game Super Bubble Pop. A single process installs all the games and a game menu

459504.overview:
BrainTalk is a brain training game that consists of a collection of memory exercises in which the player needs to remember information such as faces, names or cards. Each minigame is introduced by a screen that displays instructions. The score awarded after each exercise depends both on accuracy and speed.

Some general knowledge quiz questions are used as an interlude between exercises.

Each game session consists of 3, 5, or 7 randomly selected exercises. Up to four players can compete against each other. There are five difficulty levels.

459507.overview:
A commercial offering featuring the collective talents of demo group Eclipse. Brick Blaster is a ball-and-paddle game in the Arkanoid tradition of masonry-busting: bounce the ball around with your paddle to tear down the walls, and don't let it fall through the bottom of the screen. Three skill settings are offered, and the game's 80 levels are split into two separate groups: 'Space' and 'Arcade'.

The monsters waltzing happily across the playfield will send the ball flying in unpredictable directions; on certain levels, special teleporter bricks cause even more confusion. Some of the bricks you blast release power-ups (or power-downs!) to be caught by the paddle. In addition to the single-player game, a second player (human or computer) can jump in and share the playfield: in cooperative mode both players join forces to play for a combined score, while the duel mode pits one against the other.

459508.overview:
This game based on a plot of the famous Russian blockbuster movie "Brat 2". Main character of the game is a young Russian boy named Daniel (Danila). He learns that his brother is in the hands of the American mobsters and returns to America to help out his brother.

As with any first-person shooter game, the player will going through various levels, killing enemies using firearms and cold steel. This game also has a few adventure elements. Daniel can pick up, use and combine different items, such as cutting pipes, nails, insulation tape, etc.

459509.overview: Another game about the card game of Bridge. You can play against the computer (the A.I. has some 20 options for bidding conventions and just card play) or against human opponents (there is even a LAN option). Included are some tutorials for beginner and intermediate players; the tutorials are presented by Omar Sharif himself.

459510.overview: Bubbles is a simple Bust-A-Move / Puzzle Bobble clone, set in an underwater environment. The player takes the role of a scuba diver that must clear the screen of all the color bubbles present before they reached him. This is done by shooting the bubbles. If groups of at least three bubbles of the same color are made, these bubbles form a match and disappear. If the scuba diver cleans all the bubbles present in the game area, he will advance to the next (and more difficult) level. The ten highest scores are saved in the high score table.

459511.overview: This is a typical hunting game: The player hides behind bushes, waits until an animal crosses and shoots it. As the name suggests this game is set in Africa and uses real hunting grounds, e.g. Mutova Basin or Rutenga Wash. The graphics are still photographs. For every kill the player receives money which he uses to buy bullets and a hunting license. If he is unsuccessful he goes to jail and loses the game. The ultimate goal is to get special trophies for a museum.

459512.overview: BSE Hunter is a special German version of 3D Helicopter Coyote Hunt. While you were hunting coyotes in the original, here you have to track cows with mad cow disease. You fly with your helicopter and shoot at all cows you see. Your weapons are hunting rifle, shotgun, flame thrower and taser. A mission is done if you kill a defined amount of cows within the time limit. 20 levels are included.

459513.overview:
n BSE-Bomber the player takes control of a chopper pilot who wants to free Europe from the mad cow disease. In a top-down perspective and keyboard controls similar to Jungle Strike he has to beat 19 levels to achieve this goal.

The missions have varied goals like photographing cows or destroying bone meal containers - killing the cows is not one of them. The quicker a mission is completed the more money the player earns. This is used to buy better equipment like bigger engines, radars or cow transport cages which are needed for later missions. During the missions saving is not allowed.

459515.overview: Break It is a Break Out variant. Destroy blocks in 140 levels with the help of more than 50 power-ups that are hidden in the blocks. If you free a power-up from a block you have to catch it with your paddle. Also included is a level editor to create your own levels.

459516.overview:
In this updated version of Breakout, players take the role of "Bouncer", whose main objective is to rescue both his friends and Daisy and defeat the evil Batnix.

Gameplay is similar to the original game from 1977, but with 3D graphics and multiplayer support. Play through exotic locations like a dark prison cell, a menacing dragon-owned castle, an animal infested farm, and outer space. The game also contains numerous challenging modes, secrets and bonuses.

459517.overview:
Bridge is a single-player, mouse controlled implementation of rubber bridge, the classic four player card game.

The game has a configurable bidding system based on either of the ACOL, Five Card Majors and American Standard bidding systems. Each system has a beginner mode and an advanced mode, the latter being where the bidding extensions or conventions can be toggled on/off.

The game has sound and optional in-game music. There are no alternate table colours, no alternate card backs and no internet play option.

459518.overview: An RPG game in the dungeon crawl style of Diablo. The basic story involves you saving Heaven (not Earth) by re-combining the 5 pieces Heaven was split into by a battle with the gods and the forces of evil. Game play is hack-and-slash with limited interaction with NPCs and merchants. Characters have limited upgrades available to them as do the weapons and armor. The game was released with no printed manual (it was included on the disk, but was inaccurate to the actual game play).

459556.overview:
Build City is a city-building game set during a monarch's rule in the early 1700s. The player's job is to, as the title implies, build a city. The game constantly monitors a town's current population, gold in the treasury, and food in storage. The player has the option at first to build roads, farms, residences, and markets. Roads and farms may be built anywhere. Residences and markets must be built next to roads. After the population in a city passes certain milestones, the player also has the option to build additional structures essential for a proper city: churches (boosts religious rating), schools (boosts educational rating), medical offices (boosts health rating), and taverns (boosts recreational rating). Further, as these structures become available, nearby neighborhoods see a boost in prosperity which increases housing size as well as population.

Building things costs money as does maintaining the infrastructure on an ongoing basis. Tax money is always rolling in from the citizens in order to cover these expenses and the player can adjust the tax rate in increments of +/- 5%. Higher taxes can lead to a loss of population; lower taxes can lead to higher population but also place further burden on the infrastructure and food stores. Also, random bad things can happen in the game, such as theft from the treasury and earthquakes.

The game has 3 modes:1. Campaign: The king gives you 10 missions, each with very specific goals of increasing difficulty. Certain sets of missions build on previous missions; e.g., the first mission allows the player to build a new city from nothing while the second and third missions build on the same city from the first mission.

 - Puzzle: Solve a series of puzzles based on the pieces and characteristics from the game. E.g., with a very small plot of land (5x5 squares), grow it to a population of 60 people.
 - Open Play: No goals, just use the tools in the game to build a city for fun or practice.

459560.overview: Yet another title from Wizardworks, the creator of Deer Hunter... This one let you hunt... more deer! Have outdoorsman Jackie Bushman guide you through the forests and teach you the basics in four different locations with a full complement of rifles, bows, and other authentic outdoor gear. Go online and hunt with friends over Internet multiplayer.

459561.overview:
Bug Attack is an action shooter. You play as a killer bee that has to fight against an invasion of ants, bugs, wasps, spiders and more. Collect points and bonus weapons like knifes, rockets and bug spray. You control your bee with the arrow keys from left to right and shoot at the enemies coming from above.

Groups +

459562.overview:
The Butler Did It! is a mystery/detective adventure game which tests the player's skills in the art of deduction, logic and investigation. The premise of the game is strongly influenced by Agatha Christie, Sherlock Holmes and Clue.

The game takes place in an elaborately decorated hotel in the Swiss Alps where the wealthy and influential vacation. One such guest is the French detective Jacques-Louis Barajean, the main character. It is up to Jacques-Louis to solve a murder that has just occurred by questioning all of the guests in the hotel, gathering clues and evidence.

The difference between this and other "who-dun-nit" games is the time-limit factor. Called a "coffee break" game by the developer, each game lasts approximately 10 minutes. Replaying the game reshuffles the scenario with a new victim, suspects and accomplices so the game is never the same twice. As many as 16 people can be in residence at the hotel depending upon the season of the year. The difficulty level (selected at the beginning of the game) determines how many guests are available during the current game. The game ends when time runs out, the police are called and the murderer is taken into custody.

Completely controlled by mouse in point-and-click fashion, various icons are used for movement and zooming in to look at something closer. Clues are recorded into the Detective's notepad as they are discovered. Choosing the proper tone during an interrogation (Aggressive or Friendly) can determine how much information will be divulged by the person being questioned.

The shareware version of The Butler Did It! is much shorter with only one scenario and the fewest number of suspects.

459563.overview:
Bygg Flygplan med Mulle Meck is the third game in the series featuring the children's book character Mulle Meck (known as Gary Gadget in the US). The gameplay is about building a plane from various (unlikely) parts, and flying missions for his friends to get more parts for the plane as a reward. The setting is a rural area where the main character lives, with his friends in locations at short flying distances away on a map.

The main character Mulle Meck starts outside his hangar, with you as an invisible handyman to do the work. The available parts are inside the hangar, and needs to be taken outside to be assembled on a rotatable stand. If you are missing some vital part, you get a hint on what is lacking when you try to fly.

The game has an educational part explaining the principles of flight to help you select the proper parts for your plane, and the beginning of aviation history, though the realism factor is low, as the plane can be built of very odd bits and still fly fine, but varying the parts give the plane a different performance. When you take off, the scene changes to an overhead 3D-map, with a simplified instrument board on the lower screen; the fuel runs out quickly, and you need to refuel at your home base, so you will return there often. If you fly low, there are birds around you, and the hills can be crashed into, which means you'll start again at the home base.

On the map there are red dots which are locations of interest to visit, with airports. Once you get close, you see a mast with a windsock, and flying low over it switches you to a landing scene, where you can reduce speed and stop. Often there is a friendly character at the spot that Mulle can talk to, and get a mission from, like delivering air mail to someone else. There is no real guidance, you have to explore the map yourself to find out where all the characters are located, since you get fetch/deliver missions quite often, and sometimes the distance is further off than the fuel lasts.

There is a quick-way to warp to the home base without crashing from lack of fuel, by using a toolbox in a corner of the screen. You can only keep one plane at a time, and need to scavenge it for parts if you want to build another. Since the accumulated spare parts are quite a handful, there are shelves for keeping some order in the hangar. It is possible to save the variants you have already built for quick recall, and share them over the internet with your friends.

Originally there were also extra aircraft items to download from the publishing company's home site, but the site is now offline. One can also get several diplomas: for landing on water, landing on snow & ice, a racing diploma, aerial photography diploma, a pioneering diploma, and an honorary membership diploma from a flying circus.

459565.overview:
Created by artist Buichi Terasawa, Takeru is a full-color computerized interactive manga. Follow the hero Takeru Ichimonji in his battle against an evil sorceress in the land of Yamato, sort of an amalgam of feudal and futuristic Japan.

Interaction consists of scrolling the mouse to uncover voice-over and action events, making choices that affect the direction of the story arc, and a few object-based puzzle games. Three chapters of the comic span 2 CD-ROMs, with over 50,000 frames of digital animation. Features a fair amount of violence and, of course, scantily clad female characters.

459566.overview:
Bundesliga Manager 98 is a managerial soccer simulation where the player is responsible for the athletic and financial success of his team. The most important tasks are finding sponsors selling and buying players and setting the training. An automatic function can take over most of these duties. The player can either watch the whole match in a 3D representation, the most interesting scenes or only a text mode. During the matches he can make adjustments in tactics or lineup.

The game is basically exactly the same as Bundesliga Manager 97 without the bugs. The changes are:
 - Updated squads and teams.
 - The player can set during the matches which soccer player performs standard situations.
 - During a multiplayer game a human player can be removed.
 - There is a restriction that only two players from the junior team can be acquired for the senior squad.
 - When coaching the national team the player can arrange his own squad instead adopting the computer recommendation.

459567.overview:
Bundesliga Manager X is a typical German managerial soccer simulation where the player is responsible for the athletic and financial success of his team. The functions are divided into ten categories which can be accessed by the menus on the left and bottom of the screen. When something is going wrong the associated button glows red.

Bundesliga Manager X delivers all the aspects expected from such simulation. On the athletic side the player can set the training and the lineup. The game delivers five attack and defense tactics which are activated when certain conditions are met, when wished the player can create his own. The financial side is represented by selling and buying players, expansion of stadium and surroundings, merchandising and entry prices.

The match is shown in a real-time calculated presentation. One game lasts four minutes and during it the player can change tactics and substitute players. There are no licensed players but an editor to change the names. The 1.1 patch introduced several new features: In the career mode the player can be fired ore get hired by another club, Besides the regular match presentation there is now a text mode available. Other changes are a new negotiation mode and expendable stadium blocks.

459568.overview:
Puzzle Bobble 2 is the first sequel to "Puzzle Bobble". It was entitled in Europe and North America as Bust-A-Move Again on the arcade and Bust-A-Move 2 on the home consoles. Released into the arcades in 1995, PlayStation, Sega Saturn, Nintendo 64 and PC conversions followed. The game was included in Taito Legends 2, but the US arcade version was included on US PS2 version instead. The game is a spin-off from Bubble Bobble.

The game builds on the original by adding a tournament style variation on the two player game for play against the computer and by adding a branching map to the one player game, allowing the player to periodically select one of two groups of five levels to play next, leading to different game endings. Some of the contestants in the new tournament mode are based on characters from Bubble Bobble, including variations on a Monsta and a Mighta.

Some versions of the game, including the PlayStation, feature time trial competitions in which a single player attempts to finish simple rounds quickly enough to beat previous time records or two players simultaneously attempt to beat the records and each other.

Completion of the single player game gives the player a code which can be entered to unlock 'Another World' for the single player game, which features subtle changes to the existing levels to increase their difficulty and changes to all backdrops to resemble levels from Bubble Bobble. The various enemies from Bubble Bobble also make an appearance in the background of the credits sequence.

459569.overview:
Bygg båtar med Mulle Meck is the second game in the series featuring the children's book character Mulle Meck (known as Gary Gadget in the US). This time, Mulle has tired of just building cars (from the first game) and is asked to take care of a small shipyard by one of his friends, who is setting out on a long sea-voyage.

The gameplay is thus to build boats, by choosing a predefined hull from a set of drawings, and add additional parts for propulsion, navigation and decoration, from a wide selection available to the player from the shipyard storage. The ships range from small/medium/large rowing boats, motorboats/ships and sailing boats. Selecting the hull and material (wood/metal) is done on a slipway, from which the empty hull is launched. Outfitting the boat is done while moored to the dockside. These activities are seen from the side with Mulle and his dog Buffa looking on and commenting on your progress. Parts in storage are initially dropped in a heap on the floor, but can be sorted onto shelves in the same area. Once take out for fitting they have specific slots on each boat that can fit them; a too large engine will not fit on a small boat, and if the boat gets top-heavy, Mulle will say so.

Once you take the boat to sea, the game shifts to an overhead view, and you have a status panel at the bottom of the screen showing a compass, speed, remaining fuel, propulsion type and remaining food - in the form of a fish being eaten by Mulle. Windsocks on land and moving waves show the wind direction. Once the fuel runs out, Mulle will either use sails or oars, if available; but if the food runs out he turns back home immediately. If there are no alternate way of propulsion, a tug will take the boat back home when fuel runs out. There are some gas stations on selected islands, and some local fishermen can supply fresh food - or what passes for food in these parts; there is a factory producing cans of fermented herring - 'surströmming' which Mulle likes. The compass on the status bar also activates a map, initially incomplete, but more parts are acquired during some quests; the map gives the locations of the persons Mulle knows, and some special areas, like a racing course. During the game Mulle gets radio messages from various friends and neighbours who need transport or assistance in various ways. As a reward for each completed task, Mulle gets new parts to add to his boat, or new maps to help explore the surrounding archipelago.

A few recurring fetch quests are about an inflatable swimming ring that is found at random places, also the local parson has a tendency to lose his Bible at various beach locations, a writer needs a book located etc. Some fetch quests require the boat you have to be outfitted in a special way, e.g. multiple seats for transporting a group of people, so if those requirements are not met, the quest cannot be attempted until later.

459985.overview: Bean There, Won That is a physics driven party game designed to test your skills and your friendships! Engage in a variety of crazy minigames as you shoot, boot and bash your way up to the top of the scoreboard! Online or split-screen, you can crush your friends in your home or worldwide.

460115.overview:
The ultimate all-out warfare experience. Fight in high-intensity infantry combat. Rip through the skies in aerial dogfights. Demolish your environment for a strategic advantage. Harness complete control over every action and movement using the Kinesthetic Combat System. In a war of tanks, fighter jets, and massive combat arsenals, the deadliest weapon is your squad. This is Battlefield 6.

MULTIPLAYER
Victory, however you envision it. Battlefield 6 has more ways to win than ever before. Seize glory in iconic, large-scale modes including Conquest, Breakthrough, and Rush. Jump into fast-paced action with King of the Hill, Domination, and Payload. Change the rules of war with the revamped and refined Battlefield Portal. Fight in iconic locations all over the world including Cairo, Brooklyn, Gibraltar and more.

GLOBAL SCALE CAMPAIGN
Campaign is back. Drive tanks across the Sahara. Storm the beaches of Gibraltar. Defend New York from invasion. Join an elite squad of Marine Raiders fighting relentlessly to save a world on the edge of collapse.

PORTAL
Redraw the lines of battle. Battlefield Portal is a massive sandbox where creators and players can push Battlefield to the limit. Take unprecedented control of your environment by moving, scaling, and duplicating objects. Create a completely unique game mode using NPC scripting and a customizable UI. Legendary Battlefield experiences are waiting to be created—show ‘em what you’re made of.

THE NEW STANDARD OF FPS COMBAT
Battlefield’s new Kinesthetic Combat System makes you more connected to your soldier and environment than ever before. With overhauled gunplay and tactical movement, from crouch sprint to drag and revive, every shot and movement is more instinctual and precise.

ICONIC ALL-OUT WARFARE
Wage all-out war with infantry and vehicle combat, class-based squad play, and cutting edge audiovisual immersion. Where fighter jets, tanks, skydiving RPGS, heavy artillery, and high-intensity infantry combat become one. This is war that only happens in Battlefield.

TACTICAL DESTRUCTION
Destruction is your weapon. Make a vehicle a wrecking ball. Bury a squad under a ceiling. Demolish your surroundings for a strategic advantage. More reactive and precise than ever, audiovisual cues let you know exactly how close an object is to being destroyed. Master your environment, give your squad the edge.

460241.overview:
Taking place in a fantasy cooking world, Cupid Bistro asks: what really is the difference between cooking and alchemy? The answer, apparently, is very little; in this world, cooking delicious meals can produce fantastical effects and grant magical powers to their eaters. The player takes on the role of a restauranteur with the dream of becoming a Master Chef - the world's most powerful magical chef.

Gameplay combines business management with RPG adventuring and visual novel storytelling. In the restaurant mode, players view their restaurant from an isometric layout; they're able to customize the layout as they please while choosing what to make. Players can also research new original dishes, or even expand their empire with extra floors or new restaurants entirely. Players can also venture out of the restaurant itself into town, where they can engage in dialogue with other characters or go shopping for restaurant supplies. Characters they meet can become workers in the player's restaurant and, if their relationship is good enough, they can even participate in research to come up with unique new dishes.

In the adventure mode, players can explore the wilderness with up to two allies while bringing their best magical food with them to support them in battle.
